## Welcome to my website!

{{< include /chunks/intro.qmd >}}

#### Research Focus:

1. **Open-Source Software**: I develop open-source tools for survey construction and data science. [surveydown](/projects/2024-surveydown) is an open-source, feature-packed {{< var rnolink >}} package for programmable and reproducible surveys, combining a Quarto UI, a Shiny web framework, and a PostgreSQL backend. [sdstudio](/projects/2025-sdstudio) is a companion package as GUI and SQL support for surveydown.

2. **Transportation Research**: I study human behavior in sustainable transportation using discrete choice models. My work focuses on smart charging [adoption](/projects/2024-sc-adoption) and [economy](/projects/2025-smc-economy) analysis, providing insights to help policymakers and utilities design better systems that benefit both the grid and EV owners.
